test_select_grid_layouts.title: Each layout button shows its tile count and active state

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens with three layout buttons.

steps.action: Click the 1x1 layout button.
steps.expected: One empty tile shows and the 1x1 button is highlighted.

steps.action: Click the 2x2 layout button.
steps.expected: Four empty tiles show and the 2x2 button is highlighted.

steps.action: Click the 3x3 layout button.
steps.expected: Nine empty tiles show and the 3x3 button is highlighted.

steps.action: Click the 2x2 layout button again.
steps.expected: Four empty tiles show.

test_timer_popup_validation.title: The popup opens over a playing stream and closes on Cancel

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, open the Locations & Cameras panel, open the test site and its All Cameras group, and drag the configured test camera onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: The camera streams in the tile.

steps.action: Click the timer icon.
steps.expected: The Set Timeout Duration popup opens with Save and Cancel buttons.

steps.action: Click Cancel, then click Reset View.
steps.expected: The popup closes and the tiles are empty.

test_timer_dropdown_values.title: The duration dropdown offers the preset values

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, open the Locations & Cameras panel, open the test site and its All Cameras group, and drag the configured test camera onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: The camera streams in the tile.

steps.action: Click the timer icon.
steps.expected: The Set Timeout Duration popup opens and shows a Minutes value.

steps.action: Click the Minutes value.
steps.expected: The list shows 30 Minutes and 45 Minutes.

steps.action: Press Escape, click Cancel, then click Reset View.
steps.expected: The popup closes and the tiles are empty.

test_timer_cancel_button.title: Cancel closes the popup without saving

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, open the Locations & Cameras panel, open the test site and its All Cameras group, and drag the configured test camera onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: The camera streams in the tile.

steps.action: Click the timer icon, then click Cancel.
steps.expected: The Set Timeout Duration popup closes.

steps.action: Click Reset View.
steps.expected: The tiles are empty.

test_timer_after_page_refresh.title: The popup reopens with a value after a reload

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, open the Locations & Cameras panel, open the test site and its All Cameras group, and drag the configured test camera onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: The camera streams in the tile.

steps.action: Click the timer icon.
steps.expected: The Set Timeout Duration popup opens and shows a Minutes value.

steps.action: Click Cancel, then reload the browser page.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page loads again.

steps.action: Drag the test camera onto an empty tile, then click the timer icon again.
steps.expected: The popup opens and still shows a Minutes value.

steps.action: Click Cancel, then click Reset View.
steps.expected: The popup closes and the tiles are empty.
